Kauravacandrikā
or kauravacarita Q. in Sujana's Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā. (Adyar ms.).
See Adyar Library Bulletin VII. i. 1943, p. 41.

Kaurma(kūrma)
Upapurāṇa mentioned in Skānda, V. iii. (Revākhaṇḍa 1. verse 46-52); in Revāmāhātmya assigned to Vāyupurāṇa, Oxf. I. p. 65b. Kavīndrācārya 1365.
See also R. C. Hazra, Studies in the Upapurāṇas Vol.
, p.. 505-06, also his article ‘Some lost Up.. p.s’; JASB. Letters 1954, p. 29.

Kaurma
purāṇa (?) q. in Ānandatīrtha's Bhāgavatatātparyanirṇaya; Sarvamūla edn. [Page112-a. p.. 4 (b)-5 (a., 5 (b), 6 (a., 15 (b), 20 (a., 36 (b), 38 (a., 39 (a., 42 (b), 46 (b), 49 (b), 57 (a., 57 (b), 60 (a., 92 (a., 119 (b).
